documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our field services team struggles with missed handoffs. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer explicitly states that their field services team struggles with 'missed handoffs' and that they want 'workflow coordination and account reporting.' They have requested a discovery meeting to understand their requirements, but no budget has been approved. The account is currently in the 'qualified' stage with verified consent and ownership. The customer’s operational friction is clearly defined as 'missed handoffs' in their field services team.

claims.quote: Our field services team struggles with missed handoffs.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your field services team is experiencing challenges with 'missed handoffs,' and you are looking for workflow coordination and account reporting to address this. We are happy to schedule a discovery meeting to better understand your specific requirements and how Cedar Systems can support your needs. Please let us know a convenient time for this discussion.
questions: What specific workflows or processes are impacted by the missed handoffs in your field services team?
Are there any existing tools or systems currently being used for workflow coordination or account reporting?
What are the key performance indicators or outcomes you hope to achieve with improved workflow coordination?
uncertainties: The customer has not provided a budget, which may impact the scope or timeline of the proposed solution.
The exact nature of the 'missed handoffs' is not detailed, which may affect the customization of the solution.
